notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 5.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Sister Hospitaller, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability from step 2, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
